content.value_statement: dbt projects can become inconsistent as models, tests, and documentation grow. This skill gives practical patterns for layers, naming, tests, incremental models, and macros.
actual_capabilities: Explains staging, intermediate, and marts model layers.
Shows source definitions and column tests.
Includes incremental model patterns for merge, delete-insert, and insert overwrite.
Covers macros for repeated SQL logic and development data limits.
Lists common dbt run, test, build, docs, and debug commands.
limitations: Does not run dbt commands or connect to a warehouse.
Requires project-specific source schemas and business rules.
Examples use common Stripe and Shopify model names, not every source system.
Generated guidance still needs validation in development and CI.

use_cases.title: Standardize a New dbt Project
use_cases.description: Create model folders, naming rules, and source definitions before a team starts building transformations.

use_cases.title: Improve Data Quality Coverage
use_cases.description: Add practical tests, descriptions, and freshness checks to existing dbt models.

use_cases.title: Tune Large Transformation Runs
use_cases.description: Choose incremental strategies and development limits for large warehouse tables.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a dbt Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new analytics project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a dbt project structure for my sources, model layers, and marts. Ask for missing source details first.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tests and Documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate quality work for existing models.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my dbt models and propose tests, column descriptions, and freshness checks. Focus on practical coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Design Incremental Models
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced performance planning for large tables.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to choose incremental strategies for large dbt models. Compare merge, delete-insert, and insert overwrite for my warehouse.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Full Transformation Layer
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture review across staging, intermediate, and marts layers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to refactor my dbt transformation layer. Identify staging cleanup, shared intermediate logic, mart boundaries, and reusable macros.

output_examples.input: A team needs a consistent model layout for Stripe and Shopify sources.
output_examples.output: A staged plan with source definitions, staging models, intermediate payment summaries, customer dimensions, and order facts.

output_examples.input: An existing dbt project has weak test coverage.
output_examples.output: A prioritized test plan covering unique keys, not-null checks, relationships, accepted values, freshness, and recency checks.

output_examples.input: A large fact table takes too long to rebuild.
output_examples.output: A recommendation for an incremental strategy, unique keys, late-arriving data handling, and development data limits.

best_practices: Start with source definitions, then build staging, intermediate, and marts layers.
Add tests and documentation as models are created, not after release.
Validate materialization and incremental choices in a development target before production use.
anti_patterns: Skipping staging models and joining raw sources directly into marts.
Repeating business logic across many models instead of extracting shared intermediate models or macros.
Using incremental models without clear unique keys, late data rules, or full-refresh testing.

faq.question: What type of dbt work is this skill for?
faq.answer: It supports dbt transformation design, model organization, testing, documentation, macros, and incremental processing.

faq.question: Does this skill execute dbt commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and guidance. You must run and validate commands in your own environment.

faq.question: Can it work with any data warehouse?
faq.answer: The patterns are general, but SQL syntax and incremental behavior may need warehouse-specific adjustments.

faq.question: Can it replace a dbt project review?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure the review, but your team should validate logic, data quality, and performance.

faq.question: What inputs make the skill more useful?
faq.answer: Provide source tables, model names, warehouse type, expected marts, data volume, and known quality issues.

faq.question: Does it include examples for tests and documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for source freshness, column tests, relationship tests, and model descriptions.
